evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) often produce unreliable programs for such tasks because a user request alone rarely specifies the required APIs, dependencies, and usage conventions.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: On a benchmark of 275 ROOT tasks, grounding improves first-attempt execution from 58.5% to 76.0% under Claude Code orchestration and from 51.3% to 64.0% under standalone orchestration.
